scoring_truth: MuJoCo actual camera/world body poses at recorded measured joints, converted to RGB optical axes
fit_observations: image detected corners -> PnP, synchronized measured joint q -> Pinocchio wrist FK
stationary_pairing_limitation: Camera renders request q, while FK uses the stationary time-paired measured q; finite permitted drift is included in the residual

exact.method: Park seed + joint pseudo-Huber gradient descent with Armijo search
exact.optical_axes: x right, y down, z forward
exact.transform_convention: T_destination_from_source maps homogeneous source points into destination coordinates

variables.C_i: T_camera_from_board from the same camera color image PnP

exact.optimizer_substitution: existing X @ C_i = g_i @ Y solver receives g_i = inverse(G_i)
exact.evidence: paired measured wrist FK and camera board PnP; camera intrinsics are supplied separately
